name: Raptr
description: AI agents anyone can use: find ready-made agents, get the template to build one, and get verified world numbers. Read-only, no auth, nothing stored.

skills.name: Find agents
skills.description: Search the open agent registry (RAR) (about 1,700 single-file agents) for agents that do a task. Send the task in plain words.

skills.name: World now
skills.description: Verified snapshot of world numbers right now (Bitcoin, FX, earthquakes, space weather, ISS) with the public DOGG tick, time and SHA-256 fingerprint.
examples: what is happening in the world right now

skills.name: Agent template
skills.description: The official single-file agent template and its rules, so the calling agent can write a new agent.
